After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

Learn and grow with friends this month! Imagine you're a soccer star, sing about colors, and learn the magic words 'please' and 'thank you.' Bake alphabet cupcakes and learn that it's okay when playtime doesn't go exactly as planned.

Join JJ for some fun learning adventures at home! First, TomTom leads his lab assistants JJ and YoYo in some amazing science experiments, from making slime to building an erupting volcano! Then, it's time to head to the kitchen, where YoYo teaches JJ how to make the perfect peanut butter and jelly sandwich. The at-home fun continues as the kids discover a cassette player and record all the cool sounds they hear around the house!

Get ready for some fun animal playtime with Baby John! He and Manny are playing with their animal toys and a bus. With the help of their imagination, they travel into a fantastic animal world where their toys become real! Then, Baby John has fun in his play pretend veterinary clinic, treating his dog Bingo as one of his patients. The animal fun continues as the family tries to give a very stinky Bingo a bath!

Sing along to Baby John's favorite animal songs! First, the kids welcome a new puppy named Bingo to the family and sing the classic nursery rhyme about him! Then, the family acts out the story of Humpty Dumpty Sat on a Wall. The animal fun continues as Baby John spends the day at the aquarium and runs into Baby Shark! He learns the 'Baby Shark' dance and has an exciting dance marathon! Plus, the family dresses up like little dinosaurs!

Get ready for some sci-fi mayhem with Arpo and Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel accidentally switches Arpo to zero-gravity mode, causing the robot and everything he touches to float around the city! Then, Arpo accidentally shrinks Baby Daniel with a shrink ray and has to search frantically for the tiny toddler. The out-of-this-world adventure continues when the pesky squirrel takes Daniel on an unexpected trip to outer space in a make-believe rocket!

Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

The Minibods are having a day of drawing, painting, music and a quick fix! Newt is drawing a beautiful flower but keeps rushing and crumpling her drawings, so she must learn to slow down. Then, when the Minibods help her finish a huge painting, Newt wants it all for herself! The creative chaos continues as Lulu struggles to make a music video with a marching Oddbird and Bubbles accidentally makes a mess while trying to fix a book dispenser.

It's a day of learning lessons at parties and games! Pogo is invited to Jeff's party, but Pogo wants it to be energetic while Jeff wants it to be calm, so they must learn to compromise. Then, Newt is desperate to win a gold star at Fuse's gym challenges, but she keeps losing! She has to learn to persevere and not give up. The lessons continue as Lulu learns to wait her turn at a funfair and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy greens.

Get ready for sweet dreams and bedtime songs! Mummy helps Mia begin her nighttime routine by tucking her toys into cozy spaces. Then, they try out some super simple and calming animal-related yoga poses to help Mia have a restful sleep. Daddy also shows Mia that routines can be fun with his 'brush your teeth dance'! Finally, Mummy and Daddy play a beautiful lullaby on their guitars to help soothe the kids to sleep under the twinkling stars.

Have a calming and magical night with Twinkle the star! When Bao Bao struggles to sleep, Twinkle arrives and transforms into a hot air balloon to lift her cot into the night sky so she can see the moon. Then, she helps Max, Muffin and Bao Bao get ready for bed by transforming into a cuddly teddy bear to give them all warm goodnight hugs. From creating a magical rainbow over the bath to turning into a kite for a gentle ride, Twinkle always makes bedtime magical.
